description: Native blur view for React Native and Expo that also blurs SurfaceView video on Android, with iOS system materials and Android RenderEffect materials matched to iOS.
rules: Import the default export: import BlurView from "@nguyenduy1412/react-native-blur".
Use mode="backdrop" for overlays (headers, tab bars, cards, popups, buttons): it blurs what is behind the view and keeps its children sharp.
Use the default mode="content" to blur the BlurView's own children, such as a whole screen, an image or a playing video.
Use intensity 0 to disable the blur instead of unmounting the BlurView.
The package contains native code and does not run in Expo Go; use a development build or EAS Build.
Backdrop mode works inside <Modal transparent>; keep the modal root view transparent.
blurRadius and saturation only affect Android and Web.
